checkpoint.summary: The exact Rust codec separates realized palettes from witnessed functional-root proposals. Shipped Mozart K330-I/K331-I strict joint root/core agreement remains 63.04% / 55.93%. Preserving the pretrained quality representation and adapting its final linear map on four separate sonatas in all twelve transpositions, with one fixed atomic decoder, reaches 93.03% / 93.66% joint and 93.81% / 94.14% core agreement. The immutable function branch remains at 98.44% / 98.17% root agreement; original proofs never transfer to changed surface cores. A separately witnessed continuation recovers .75 quarter of K331 function. The teacher has known Mozart training overlap: these are development experiments, not shipped inference or independent validation. Requested 100% remains unmet; strict denominators and observations stay fixed and no holdout is parsed.
nextActions: Close realized-core and boundary errors jointly. Atomic source frames plus explicit pitched-silence holds can represent 100% of supported reference timing; this oracle says nothing about selecting labels. Remaining surface errors include absent suspended-third vocabulary and poorly ranked implied/seventh members. Do not freeze the decoder's selected windows or alter the strict denominator.

Retain the reproducible four-work pretrained quality-readout control. Joint degree/quality correction, direct function supervision and the six-work quality fit underperform; no per-work oracle selection or further blind head sweeps. K283-III improves both works but repairs none of their I(64) replacements. More examples alone do not resolve this output-structure gap.

Teach executable parent-to-realization operations, not only exact sounding cores. A shared four-operation mixture gains only .5 quarter and fails to recover the relation in fresh sustained/broken controls despite correct cores. Baseline bypass absorbs 99.48% of correct-parent V(64) training responsibility; priors also omit explicit parent conditioning. Extract supported operations from training annotation syntax, verify exact compiled compatibility, and provide parent-relative observed-note/span evidence. Preserve immutable function, domain ambiguity, invalid mass and matched decoder/disabled/initial controls. Do not tune the failed mixture.

Preserve explicit functional-span evidence separately from native immediate-neighbor proof. Identical core and bass alone are insufficient; the narrow successful continuation also requires uniformly predicted second inversion. Keep unresolved direct-to-tonic and changing-bass cases separate. Retain one maintained capture/fit/decode/evaluate path with immutable function/surface layers and strict source/timebase admission.

Require continuity, independent seventh, ambiguity and track-repartition controls when changing scoring. Missing members can be implied by surrounding harmony; passing/neighbor motion can be structurally chordal. These musical distinctions constrain any learned or hand-written proposal.

Preserve an edited composition program independently of reanalysis. Keep source observations, authored parameters and inferred evidence distinct; a new inverse reading must not erase an authored dependency.
After representation/ranking choices are frozen, evaluate held-out work lineages once, alongside exact reconstruction, useful edits, runtime and explanatory cost.
